name: sitepen-spreadsheet
description: The workbook editor and its calculation engine, with example apps
author: Anthony Gubler

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build -w @sitepen/demo && npm run build -w @sitepen/react-portal
scripts.pages:dev: node scripts/build-sites.mjs demo && wrangler pages dev --cwd examples/demo --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:demo && npm run deploy:portal && npm run deploy:angular
scripts.deploy:demo: node scripts/build-sites.mjs demo && wrangler pages deploy --cwd examples/demo --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:portal: node scripts/build-sites.mjs portal && wrangler pages deploy --cwd examples/react-portal --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:angular: node scripts/build-sites.mjs angular && wrangler pages deploy --cwd examples/angular-portal --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.docs:dev: npm run build:lib && npm install --prefix docs && npm run dev --prefix docs
scripts.build:docs: npm run build:lib && npm install --prefix docs && npm run build --prefix docs
scripts.deploy:docs: npm run build:docs && wrangler pages deploy --cwd docs --branch main --commit-dirty=true
